backup_minimum_enforced_retention_durati.description: Required. Minimum enforced retention duration for backups stored in the backup vault. Minimum enforced retention duration should be at least 100000s
backup_minimum_enforced_retention_durati.rationale: Prevents premature deletion of backups and supports recovery and retention requirements.

location.description: Required. The GCP location for the backup vault should be on approved region.
location.rationale: Location determines physical hosting region and data residency.

backup_vault_id.description: Required. ID of the requesting object.
backup_vault_id.rationale: This field is an identifier used for referencing the backup vault.

description.description: Optional. The description of the BackupVault instance (2048 characters or less).
description.rationale: Description has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

labels.description: Optional. Resource labels to represent user provided metadata. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels have no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

effective_time.description: Optional. Time after which the BackupVault resource is locked.
effective_time.rationale: Effective time has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

annotations.description: Optional. User annotations. See https://google.aip.dev/128#annotations Stores small amounts of arbitrary data. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_annotations` for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: Annotations have no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

access_restriction.description: Required. Specifies the access restriction level for the backup vault. Restricted WITHIN_ORGANIZATION only
access_restriction.rationale: Controls where backup data can be accessed from. Unrestricted access increases threats

backup_retention_inheritance.description: How a backup's enforced retention end time is inherited. Default value is `INHERIT_VAULT_RETENTION` if not provided during creation. Possible values are: `BACKUP_RETENTION_INHERITANCE_UNSPECIFIED`, `INHERIT_VAULT_RETENTION`, `MATCH_BACKUP_EXPIRE_TIME`.
backup_retention_inheritance.rationale: Inheritance ensures retention policies defined at the backup vault level are consistently enforced.

force_update.description: Required. Forces updates to the backup vault configuration even if they might disrupt operations.
force_update.rationale: Force updates may override protective measures and result in unwanted changes to configuration or data.

force_delete.description: Overrides deletion safeguards and allows forced deletion of a backup vault.
force_delete.rationale: Forcing deletion of a backup vault can result in permanent loss of backup data.

ignore_inactive_datasources.description: If set, the following restrictions against deletion of the backup vault instance can be overridden: * deletion of a backup vault instance containing no backups, but still containing empty datasources.
ignore_inactive_datasources.rationale: Deletion behavior option; not enforced by policy.

ignore_backup_plan_references.description: If set, the following restrictions against deletion of the backup vault instance can be overridden: * deletion of a backup vault instance that is being referenced by an active backup plan.
ignore_backup_plan_references.rationale: Deletion behavior option; not enforced by policy.

allow_missing.description: Allow idempotent deletion of backup vault. The request will still succeed in case the backup vault does not exist.
allow_missing.rationale: Idempotent delete behavior; not enforced by policy.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: even without manual ID configuration ID will be automatically generated.
